workspaceId.description: Workspace the Session joins; exclusive with `cwd`.

cwd.description: Directory the Session owns when no Workspace is named.

sessionId.description: Blank Session to reuse while it is reusable, or the identity of a new Session when none is stored under it.

agentPreset.description: Preset the Session runs, replacing a reused Session's recorded preset; the configured default when omitted.
